in_sanskrit.name: तपस्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the root word 'Tap' meaning 'Heat', 'Sun', or 'Penance'. This name is associated with the god Agni, who is the god of fire and the deity of the ritual sacrifice in Hinduism. It is also a name of Shiva, the god of destruction and regeneration.

in_hindi.name: तपस
in_hindi.long_meaning: तपस् (tapas) is a Sanskrit word which is derived from the root word 'Tap' meaning 'Heat'. In Hinduism, it is associated with penance, self-discipline, and meditation. The word 'Tapasvi' or 'Tapasi' means 'one who practices Tapas'. The name Tapas is also associated with the god Agni, who is the god of fire and the deity of the ritual sacrifice.

in_tamil.name: தபச்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil word 'தபச்' (tapas) is derived from the Sanskrit word 'तपस्' (tapas). It means 'Heat' or 'Sun' in Tamil. In Hinduism, it is associated with penance, self-discipline, and meditation. It is also used to denote authority or power.

in_telugu.name: తెపెశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu word 'తెపెశ్' (tepeśa) is derived from the Sanskrit word 'तपस्' (tapas). It means 'Heat' or 'Sun' in Telugu. In Hinduism, it is associated with penance, self-discipline, and meditation. It is also used to denote authority or power.

in_marathi.name: Tapash
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे He who ignites
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tapash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। God of the Morning Sun, the god of wisdom and knowledge, the one who ignites and kindles, the one who nourishes and sustains.

in_bengali.name: Tapash
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ He who ignites
in_bengali.long_meaning: Tapash একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। God of the Morning Sun, the god of wisdom and knowledge, the one who ignites and kindles, the one who nourishes and sustains.
